create.title: Universal alpha seam incidence and missing actual seam specification
create.statement_tex: For a generic moving seam W_s=W_-+Delta W S^*(L_s-L_0), differentiating the complete finite two-axis Cauchy-Green ledger gives explicit first-connector delta terms and mixed delta/delta-prime terms. The sixteen grouped strata reassemble the original right-line seam with relative coefficient +1; they do not cancel it identically. The accepted state does not define an actual alpha seam coefficient for an H_j floor, product star, dyadic profile edge, or radial endpoint: it lacks the common finite alpha numerator, a typed primal seam map, the full jump, face/axis pullbacks and velocities, and collision regularization with the Plemelj distribution. Therefore neither zero nor a nonzero actual coefficient is presently determined. Equality-star value one-half does not halve the distributional jump, and the beta sixteen-cell geometry cannot be substituted for an undefined alpha seam.
create.next_action: Freeze only the first H_j-floor transition from the exact finite alpha amplitude, with a declared varied scale coordinate, full adjacent traces, all stratum pullbacks, and joint Plemelj collision rule.

update.statement_tex: The connector-completed alpha-bounded zeta-high trace remains the signed projected cosine-comb/GAR-return operator with moving multiplier m_lambda(beta)=(1-psi(beta))psi(beta+lambda). Zero mass and packetwise BV do not control lattice/floor/star jumps. The universal sixteen-cell seam ledger reconstructs a generic right-line jump with relative coefficient +1 rather than cancelling it. Before any actual signed seam theorem can be attempted, define from the exact finite alpha antecedent the first H_j-floor event: one typed varied scale coordinate, its coupled changes in the height indicator, Vaaler profile, (H_j+1)^v power and denominator profile, the common numerator, all face/axis pullbacks and velocities, equality convention, and joint Plemelj collision rule. Then prove its complete signed incidence is zero or target-sized, followed by the outside-height Cauchy limit and global arithmetic sum. No actual coefficient is currently determined.
update.next_action: Derive the exact first H_j-floor adjacent-scale seam from the finite alpha amplitude, or prove that H_j is not a lawful continuous seam variable and replace the incidence target by a discrete adjacent-scale difference identity.

reject.reason: The sixteen finite Stokes strata reconstruct the original right-line seam as an operator identity. They are not scalar incidence coefficients whose labels add to zero.
A star fixes the point value at equality but the distributional derivative of the corresponding step has full delta mass. At a Plemelj pole a separate joint regularization is required.

The accepted beta geometry does not supply the endpoint-free alpha numerator, typed primal seam map, jump traces, pullbacks, velocities, or collision rule needed to evaluate even the terminal alpha coefficient.
